item.title: 分析师称 OpenAI 的广告业务将比自己的预测低 90%
item.description:
📝 今年广告收入将达到 50 亿美元，到 2030 年将达到 1000 亿美元。 Trishla Ostwal Trishla 是《广告周刊》的特约记者，报道人工智能和科技领域的问题。 @trishlaostwal|特里什拉。
🔤 Original: OpenAI's Ad Business Is on Pace to Miss Its Own Forecast by 90%, Analyst Says
🔗 Read more: https://www.adweek.com/media/openais-ad-business-is-on-pace-to-miss-its-own-forecast-by-90-analyst-says/
